comment.text: Placeholder of the optional text area in the AI metadata panel where the user can type extra instructions for AI.

usage.context:
<Textarea
 wrapperClassName={styles.prompt}
 className={styles.promptField}
 value={prompt}
 onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
 placeholder={t("Metadata:AIPromptPlaceholder")}
 maxLength={METADATA_AI_PROMPT_MAX_LENGTH}
 heightTextArea="64px"
 fontSize={13}
 isDisabled={isAnalyzing}
 dataTestId="metadata_ai_prompt_textarea"
